quote: The operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter shall not: Overtake and pass a motor vehicle unless the operator can do so safely without endangering himself or herself or the occupants of the motor vehicle.

activation.condition: qualifying cycle or scooter operator overtakes and passes a motor vehicle

obligation.description: operator must not overtake and pass unless able to do so safely without endangering the operator or motor-vehicle occupants
obligation.source_clause: The operator of a bicycle, an electric bicycle or an electric scooter shall not: Overtake and pass a motor vehicle unless the operator can do so safely without endangering himself or herself or the occupants of the motor vehicle.

timing.description: entire observed pass from behind until clear ahead

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: Overtake and pass a motor vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Verify the qualifying rider and motor-vehicle classes and an original behind-to-clear-ahead pass.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: safely without endangering himself or herself or the occupants of the motor vehicle
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure the full-body gap, closing motion, passing side and occupant evidence over the whole pass; no numeric legal threshold is supplied.

parameter_refs.name: rider_y_m
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: source-checked lateral center within the one-way through lanes

parameter_refs.name: motor_vehicle_context
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original motor-vehicle class, full body and occupant evidence
